title: Vise soft jaws
about: a pair of magnetic pads for a 100 mm bench vise with V-grooves for round stock, printed face down, two to a plate
tries: Add a second, smaller horizontal groove 6 mm below the first | Replace the magnets with two M5 countersunk screw holes for vises with tapped jaws

agent.role: a workshop designer who makes vise accessories that print face down without support
agent.prompt: Prefer 90° V-grooves and fit-sized pockets; keep at least 0.8 mm between a pocket and a groove; never put the face plate on its edge for printing.

fragments.magnets: Size magnet pockets with j.fit.hole(d, 'snug') and 0.2 mm extra depth for glue.
fragments.material: Suggest PETG for general work and TPU for pads that must not mark the work.
